title: 5x-review-4: review ecosystem integration
description:
## Parent

sutra/150 — Code-anchored lessons: sutra_remember / contextual surfacing

## What to review

Final checkpoint. vidhi-reflect writes and prunes the lessons store. Existing ledger.md content migrated. CLAUDE.md updated. The system is fully operational end-to-end.

**Reviewer focus:**
- vidhi-reflect skill correctness — does the new process produce good lessons with good anchors?
- Migration quality — do L1–L12 have correct anchor assignments? Do they surface in the right contexts?
- CLAUDE.md pointer wording — is the instruction clear enough for agents to know when/how to write lessons and cite them?
- End-to-end flow — walk through a scenario: agent fixes a bug, writes a lesson, another agent reads the symbol and sees it, cites it in a close-out, vidhi-reflect prunes stale ones. Does the whole loop work?

## Blocked by

- sutra/163 — vidhi-reflect evolution
- sutra/164 — Migration of ledger.md + CLAUDE.md update
execution_record: Reviewed all four focus areas. SKILL.md: correct, no changes needed. Migration: 5/12 correctly migrated with good primary anchors; 7 correctly skipped. CLAUDE.md pointer: fixed stale ledger.md path (removed entirely — agents don't need provenance breadcrumbs). End-to-end: confirmed lessons surface via sutra_read/impact/orient, citations work, verification lifecycle works. Found and filed sutra/177 for import_pattern anchor over-broadness (parking_lot::* on all 5 lessons). Added metadata table as proper migration (0005). Archived orphaned test lesson from sutra/162 review.
